headline: QVC RUNS 60,000 HOURS OF LIVE TELEVISION A YEAR AND 200 HOURS A WEEK ON TIKTOK, AND IT SAYS THE SMALL ONE BROUGHT IN OVER A MILLION CUSTOMERS WHO HAD NEVER BOUGHT FROM IT AT ALL
deck: Modern Retail published a long interview with QVC's head of social commerce this morning.  The business built on live television selling now runs a second live operation at roughly a sixth of the airtime, and that is where the new customers came from.  The channel is not the interesting part.  The interesting part is that QVC rebuilt the format, built separate studios for it, and changed the number it coaches its presenters on.
tldr: QVC runs about 200 hours of live selling a week on TikTok against roughly 1,150 hours of television, and says the smaller operation brought in over a million customers last year who had never bought from it on television or its website.  Rebuild your live or long-form format for a second platform from scratch rather than cutting the existing one down, and coach your on-camera talent to watch click-through and click-to-order instead of revenue.

Meta says ad sets under about fifty conversions a week run about 28 percent more expensive per purchase, and discloses no sample size, period or baseline behind it.  Divide your weekly budget by your cost per purchase and then by fifty before your next creator test, and test only that many creators at once.

Co-streaming hours across 15 major esports tournaments grew 19.7 percent while the official broadcasts fell 5.4 percent, and one event went from 83 community channels to 675.  Ask for official-feed and co-stream figures as separate lines on every live sponsorship, price only the feed your brand is carried on, and put average concurrent viewers in the contract rather than hours watched.

A supermarket and an electronics maker are being sued over a TikTok song used in videos that did 6,231 and 2,938 views, with damages set by law reaching 150,000 dollars a work where a court finds the use was deliberate.  Name the person who certifies that published audio is cleared for commercial use, put it in the contract this week, and make your own licensed library the only source your editors pull from.

SharkNinja says an offshore oil-field worker's video using a facial cleansing device did over 10 million views, and names the unexpected demonstrator and the visible residue in the device as the reasons.  Cast one slot in your next product demonstration from outside the category entirely, and pick products whose result a viewer can see with the sound off.

Accenture closed its purchase of a creator agency running about 600 million dollars of campaigns a year, while Omnicom's creative discipline shrank and it disclosed no creator spend at all.  Pitch consultancies and brand in-house teams alongside agencies, leading with finished video at volume and a fixed monthly price rather than with ideas.

46 percent of brands plan to sell through their own website this Christmas, down from 69 percent last year, while 49 percent say their own website matters more at Christmas.  Change what you report on one owned video property from sales to onward actions — brand searches, later visits, retailer page views — and agree that measure with the client before the quarter starts.

The business built on live television selling now runs a second live operation at roughly a sixth of the airtime, and that is where the new customers came from.  The channel is not the interesting part.  The interesting part is that QVC rebuilt the format, built separate studios for it, and changed the number it coaches its presenters on.

Rebuild your live or long-form format for a second platform from scratch rather than cutting the existing one down, and coach your on-camera talent to watch click-through and click-to-order instead of revenue.
